admissionEvidence.inference: NEW local TCP from either named peer reaches UFW INPUT DROP for both ports; WARP source192.168.0.0/16 accepts.

interface.scope: kernel interface-address metadata; no packet capture

authority: Existing login sudoers/PAM via sudo_start only; no permission or sudoers changes.
beforeGates: Pin root-owned UFW entry, the six reviewed implementation files, nft and xtables; require current br0 owns .11 and both QA ports remain unoccupied.
Create new private backup root and copy all listed persistent files plus the complete fresh native command stdout/stderr and authority records; reject missing/incomplete/truncated/changing sources.
Require UFW enabled and its IPv4/IPv6 user-chain families complete as the installed _need_reload implementation expects.

Reject either nonempty comment already present; reject any existing persisted or live rule matching the same core flow regardless of its action/logtype/comment. No replace/update/insert branch is authorized.

Capture the full normalized before-state; only counters, generated timestamps and nft handle identities may be removed from semantic comparison. Preserve every other field, rule order within each chain, and duplicate multiplicity.

comparison.iptables: Normalize bracket counters and generated timestamp comment lines only, shlex-tokenize each ordered chain rule; compare entire tables after removing exactly the expected new flow rules.
comparison.nft: Group tables/chains/rules by their full identity while preserving rule order and duplicate counts per chain. Remove dynamic counters and handles only. Exclude exactly the two source/destination/iif/tcp-range/accept rules from ip/filter/ufw-user-input and require all remaining manager semantics equal. Unknown expressions/schema differences refuse rather than being dropped.
comparison.otherPersistentFiles: All bytes and owner/group/mode/nlink unchanged, including user6.rules.
comparison.persistentUserRules: Retain ordered tuple/block structure, comments and all existing directives; decode only the two expected nonempty hexadecimal comments, verify their complete IPv4/in_br0/allow/tcp/source/destination/port tuple plus generated ACCEPT body, remove those blocks and require the prior persistent semantics unchanged.

execution: Issue add for Mac peer once; collect original PTY bytes and natural exit state; capture current full rules and persistent files before proceeding.

Require exactly the first owned IPv4 tuple and kernel rule appended, with all prior rules/config ownership and unrelated manager semantics unchanged. Any failure or missing authority stops the second add.
Issue add for X230 peer once under the same checks; require exactly two owned tuples/rules and no other semantic changes.
Only after both known successful postconditions may the new normal Rust port diagnostic and the separately reviewed HA128 r2 run start. The original HA r1 remains failed.
persistenceCaveat: Installed UFW writes the existing user.rules via shutil.copy from its tempfile, not an atomic rename. Exit code alone is insufficient: persisted and live exact postconditions are both mandatory.

rollback.afterEach: Record original result and fresh full snapshots; only the corresponding owned rule may disappear. All other manager semantics and existing persistent configuration remain equivalent.
rollback.final: Both unique comments and both new live flow rules absent; normalized firewall semantics equal before; original backup preserved.
rollback.materialSideEffect: Installed UFW 0.36.2 exact deletion unconditionally reloads UFW user chains through iptables-restore -n (and IPv6 when enabled), rebuilding its logging/user rules and resetting relevant counters. Counter values and nft handles are not promised to be restored. No global flush/disable/reset or raw backup restore is authorized.
rollback.method: Execute only each full remove argv above, with its same nonempty unique comment. Never delete by numeric index.
rollback.precondition: Re-read exact persistent comment+full tuple and corresponding unique live rule; require recorded ownership and known original attempt state. Absent/changed/ambiguous rules are reconciled, not blindly removed.
rollback.when: After owned diagnostics/HA processes are fully closed, or after a known failure with exact owned-rule poststate; never while network effects remain unknown.

scope: Only the two named peers may reach the two QA TCP ports on the existing br0 LAN address.
unknownPolicy: Any lost sudo_start/PTY acknowledgement is indeterminate. Keep original session/request identity; reconcile that original terminal, exact comments and live/config rules. Do not re-add with a new identity, repeat an unknown mutator, or restore a whole older firewall over concurrent changes.
